mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 240, it signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 240, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) triggers central bank hawkishness, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when CPIAUCSL > 240, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects strong economic output, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, increasing wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer and business demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both rise, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200, it signals strong residential construction activity, boosting economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
